purpose: Terse, unfielded Google Scholar style keyword queries (e.g. 'accomazzi europa') whose main difficulty is disambiguation: author surnames versus missions and telescopes named after people, eponymous scientific terms, astronomical objects, facility filters, years and topic phrases. Scored by scripts/evaluate_keyword_queries.py.
review_status: approved by Stephanie on 2026-09-25 (mission after a surname labelled as topic; kw-st-001 reworded to 'accomazzi europe')

label_conventions.authors: ADS author strings: 'Last' for a bare surname, 'Last, First' when the query gives a first name. Scoring compares surname plus first initial, ignoring case, accents, hyphens and comma order; an initial is only compared when both sides give one.
label_conventions.topic_terms: the abs: phrases, grouped as a searcher would quote them. Scored as an exact set of phrases (grouping matters) and as word-level F1 (grouping ignored). An astronomical object is kept in topic_terms as an abs: term.
label_conventions.object: metadata only, not scored: which topic_terms name an astronomical object. gold_query writes objects as abs: terms because the ADS search API rejects object: ('undefined field object').
label_conventions.bibgroup: a facility typed as a filter in front of a topic ('jwst brown dwarfs') is its bibgroup; a mission paired with a surname ('jarmak cassini') is the topic, and a facility inside a name ('hubble deep field', 'chandra deep field south') is a topic phrase. Items where the other reading is reasonable are marked ambiguous.
label_conventions.years: year_from/year_to inclusive; a single year is year_from == year_to; 'since Y' is [Y, null]; 'before Y' is [null, Y-1]; a decade is its ten years.
label_conventions.operator: none for every item; no query asks for a result-set transform.
label_conventions.first_author: false for every item; no query asks for first-author position.
label_conventions.gold_query: assembled from the gold fields by the repo's assemble_query, except that a '*' inside a quoted phrase is escaped (the assembler leaves 'sgr a*' unescaped and ADS then finds nothing).
label_conventions.ambiguous: true when a second reading is also reasonable; the note says which.
